notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.5.14 is an emergency startup recovery release for the v0.5.13 host regression. It preserves the v0.5.13 profile-first race-night UI and all app data/features, restores the last known-good external pythonw launch model, strips inherited PyInstaller parent-process state before launching the runtime, removes the frozen-host Tkinter failure path, and restores the earlier stable shell/AppUserModelID handling. A standalone Recovery EXE is also published so a broken v0.5.13 install can repair itself without opening the app. Garage/model fixes are intentionally paused until startup is stable again.
